html:
Ngawang Lobsang Gyatso, the 5th Dalai Lama, was the first Dalai Lama to rule Tibet as well as lead its religion. Tibetans call him the Great Fifth.

In 1642 his Mongol ally Güshi Khan defeated the rival king of Tsang and handed power over Tibet to him. His government, the Ganden Phodrang, ruled from Lhasa until 1959. In 1645 he began the Potala Palace on a hill above the city.

He was a scholar and a skilled politician. In 1652 he travelled to Beijing to meet the young Shunzhi Emperor of the new Qing dynasty. He also recognised the Mongol prince Zanabazar as a high reincarnate lama.

When he died in 1682, his regent Desi Sangye Gyatso kept the death secret for about fifteen years so the work on the Potala could be finished.
